notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.56 — Add secure offline one-time PC-to-laptop Pipeline transfer. Pipeline progress is device-local, so updating Hub code or signing into MBL never automatically copies the PC checklists. Both Windows devices now show Settings > PC ↔ Laptop · Pipeline transfer with Export from this PC and Import from PC. The export contains candidate identities and only Pipeline-specific checkboxes, contract/onboarding progress, stage timestamps, ridealong details, removed/finished status and independent stopwatch start times; it never contains MBL authentication tokens, passwords, full private candidate histories or pending official write queues. On laptop import, exact official MBL IDs are matched first, with one-to-one verified name+phone/email fallback for old locally added records. The Hub previews updated/added/skipped counts and asks confirmation, makes a timestamped backup of the laptop candidate database before any changes, preserves official MBL stages, induction bookings, local notes and prior candidate histories, and then applies the PC's Pipeline progress. Unmatched candidates are added only to the local Hub and not sent to MBL. The transfer is an offline JSON file, not a live sync service; the JSON contains personal candidate contact details and must be kept private. Existing induction roster, attendance verification, and official MBL connection behavior are unchanged. Regression tests cover confidentiality, matching, idempotence, stopwatch survival, local backups and no official MBL writes.
